externalNote: Every file this repository reads and may not ship, or fetches rather than carries. Each lives under external/, which git and Dropbox both ignore. python3 -m conformance.external reports which are here, which are missing and which are not the file named; SHA-256 alone decides a file, and HEAD decides a checkout.
